issues.description: Field SealSaloon.totalOrders: the problem statement UML (problem_statement.md) declares the attribute as type int, whereas the solution implementation (src/de/tum/cit/ase/SealSaloon.java) declares the field as type long. This mismatch may confuse students about which numeric type to use for the totalOrders attribute and which getter signature to implement.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the type consistent across artifacts. Either update the UML in problem_statement.md to declare 'totalOrders: long' to match the solution, or change the solution's SealSaloon.totalOrders field (and its getter) to int so it matches the UML. Also document the intended choice in the problem text to avoid ambiguity for students.
